overview: Action Sports covers skateboarding and snowboarding safety, equipment maintenance, park/slope etiquette, fundamental and intermediate maneuvers, and outdoor stewardship.

requirements.topic_heading: Hazards, Safety Gear & First Aid in Action Sports
requirements.req_text: Do the following: (a) Explain to your counselor the most likely hazards you may encounter while participating in action sports (skateboarding or snowboarding) and what you should do to anticipate, help prevent, mitigate, and respond to these hazards. (b) Review prevention, symptoms, and first-aid treatment for hypothermia, frostbite, dehydration, sunburn, heat exhaustion, heatstroke, blisters, sprains, strains, fractures, head/concussion injuries, and spinal injuries. (c) Show your helmet, wrist guards, knee/elbow pads, boots, and bindings, and explain how to inspect and fit them properly.

pamphlet_excerpts: Action Sports Sub-Req 5a: Demonstrate three intermediate maneuvers or tricks approved by your counselor in a supervised skatepark or snow terrain park.
Action Sports Sub-Req 5b: Explain Leave No Trace and outdoor stewardship principles at mountain resorts and community skateparks, and explore careers or volunteer roles (such as National Ski.
Core Standard 1 (Req 5): Do the following: (a) Demonstrate three intermediate maneuvers or tricks approved by your counselor in a supervised skatepark or snow terrain park.

Core Standard 2 (Req 5): (b) Explain Leave No Trace and outdoor stewardship principles at mountain resorts and community skateparks, and explore careers or volunteer roles (such as National Ski Patrol, adaptive sports instructor, or equipment engineer) in action sports.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 5): Review the official Action Sports requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing Action Sports Careers, Training & Hobby Pathways.
Execute & Document: Perform the demonstrate task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Action Sports Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.
